documents.title: Johnson County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 94 pages. Amounts are the Section 6 Maximum Appropriated Amounts / fund BUDGET lines; office sheets' 2026 SUBTOTAL and TOTALS rows column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
